segmente.text: Your business has an attention problem.
But the solution is not that you have to post more.
Attention is not gained only because of frequency.
It is gained because the brain understands immediately why it should care.
When content feels unclear, the brain automatically treats it as irrelevant.
That's why posting more often doesn't help.
Comment the word attention if you want me to share a short training on how attention really works.
